overrides.rationale: Planned +25% Southeast beverage demand in July (seasonal peak): "What if Southeast beverage demand rises 25% in July?" Assumptions recorded: magnitude exactly +25% (scale 1.25); window = the 4 ISO weeks whose Monday falls in July 2026 (2026-W28..W31, 2026-07-06 to 2026-08-02); scope = all Beverages SKUs at all Southeast DCs (100 SKUs across RDC02, RDC03, CDC03–CDC06, 397 demand lines); visibility = both sides (planner did not say whether the business sees it coming, so MEIO plans for it and the Twin simulates it; the unprepared arm already covers the surprise case). Pure volume surge: no price event, no volatility change, no capacity change.
